emails.subject: What brought you here?
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

In about a month, we'll gather for three days that could change everything.

But today, I want to ask you something: What brought you here?

Not how you found the registration link. Not who told you about the summit. I mean — what in your life whispered (or maybe shouted) that it was time for something different?

Maybe you're tired of living by reaction instead of alignment.

Maybe you've achieved everything you were supposed to want, and something still feels missing.

Maybe you're standing in the middle of a transition you didn't choose, wondering who you'll be on the other side.

Or maybe you just know — with that deep, wordless knowing — that there's more truth available to you than you've been living.

Whatever brought you here: trust it.

Life by Design isn't about fixing what's broken. It's about remembering what's true. It's about choosing — consciously, deliberately, sacredly — how you want to show up in your own life.

Over the next 30 days, I'll be writing to you about what we'll explore together. The speakers. The teachings. The experience of being in a room full of people who are done performing and ready to become.

But today, just sit with the question: What brought you here?

The answer matters. It will be the thread you follow through everything we do together.

emails.subject: The power of designing your life
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

There's a difference between living and designing your life.

Living is what happens when you react to whatever shows up. The demands. The expectations. The emergencies and obligations and shoulds that fill your calendar before you've even decided what matters.

Designing is what happens when you pause — really pause — and ask: What do I actually want? Who am I becoming? What would it look like to live in alignment with that truth?

Most of us weren't taught to design our lives. We were taught to survive them. To get through. To check the boxes and hope that somewhere, someday, we'd feel like ourselves again.

But here's what I know: You don't have to wait for permission. You don't need a crisis to justify change. You can simply decide — today, right now — that you're going to start living by design instead of by default.

At the summit, we'll give you tools for this. Frameworks. Practices. Real stories from people who made the shift.

But the shift itself? That starts with a decision. And maybe — just maybe — registering for this summit was yours.

emails.subject: Meet the voices who will guide us
emails.needs_update: Names the July speakers (Turiya, John Carter, Michelle Willard, Matthew Hammond). April lineup is not confirmed.
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

I want to introduce you to some of the people who will share their wisdom, their stories, and their hard-won truth with us at Life by Design.

These aren't performers. They're practitioners. People who have walked through fire and come out the other side with something real to offer.

🎤 Turiya — My co-host and fellow traveler in this work. She brings a depth of presence and a gift for holding space that transforms every room she enters.

🎤 John Carter — A voice of practical wisdom and embodied truth. His story reminds us that transformation isn't theoretical — it's lived, one choice at a time.

🎤 Michelle Willard — Her journey speaks to the power of reclaiming your voice and your vision when both have been buried under survival.

🎤 Matthew Hammond — A testament to what's possible when you stop negotiating with your own potential and start claiming it.

And me — Babs. I'll be there every day, holding the container, asking the questions, and sharing what I've learned about alignment, identity, and the sacred work of becoming.

Each of us has a different piece of the puzzle. Together, we're going to map something that matters.

emails.subject: What to expect when we gather
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

Three weeks from today, we'll be together.

I want you to know what you're walking into — because it's not a typical summit.

Yes, there will be speakers. Yes, there will be teaching. But what we're creating together is something more like a sanctuary. A space where you can exhale. Where you don't have to perform or pretend. Where you can simply be present with what's true and let it shift you.

Here's what the days will feel like:

🌅 Morning: Grounding and intention-setting. We don't rush in. We arrive.

🎤 Midday: Deep teaching and storytelling. Real talk about real transformation.

💬 Breakouts: Connection with fellow travelers. You're not alone in this.

🌆 Closing: Integration and reflection. Not just information — embodiment.

Between sessions, you'll have space to breathe. To journal. To let what you're hearing land in your body, not just your mind.

And at the end of three days? You'll have a clearer sense of who you are, what you want, and how to move toward it with aligned action.

That's the promise. That's the design.

emails.subject: The Yellow Light in action
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

I want to teach you something that will change everything.

Most of us live in reaction mode. Something happens → we react. Someone asks → we say yes. A feeling arises → we distract ourselves. We're constantly responding to life without ever pausing to ask: Is this aligned?

I call this living at the Red Light. Stop. Go. Stop. Go. No space. No choice. Just momentum and survival.

But there's another way. I call it the Yellow Light.

The Yellow Light is the pause between stimulus and response. It's the breath you take before you answer. The moment of checking in with yourself before you commit. The sacred space where you remember: I have a choice here.

At the summit, we'll practice this. A lot. Because designing your life requires the Yellow Light. You can't build something intentional while you're running on autopilot.

The Yellow Light asks:

• What do I actually want here?
• Is this aligned with who I'm becoming?
• What's the faithful next step?

Simple questions. Profound impact.

Start practicing now. Notice where you're living at Red Light. Where you could choose Yellow instead.

It will prepare you for what we're going to do together.

emails.subject: Your travel partners await
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

I need to tell you something important: You're not doing this alone.

Yes, the summit is about your life. Your design. Your next chapter. But transformation doesn't happen in isolation. It happens in community. In the presence of others who are also willing to be real, to be seen, to be becoming.

The people who will gather with you on July 23-25? They're your travel partners.

Some are in the middle of massive transitions. Some are rebuilding after loss. Some are finally claiming dreams they've buried for decades. All of them are showing up with open hearts and a willingness to do the work.

You won't be the only one who's scared. You won't be the only one who doesn't have it figured out. You won't be the only one who's hoping — really hoping — that something shifts.

That's the beauty of gathering. We remember that we're not alone. That our struggles aren't unique failures, but shared human experiences. That our becoming is braided together with the becoming of everyone around us.

So come ready to connect. To share. To be witnessed and to witness.

Your travel partners are waiting.

emails.subject: The 12 Dimensions of a life well-designed
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

I want to give you a preview of something we'll explore deeply at the summit.

I call it the LifeCharter — a framework for examining your life across 12 dimensions:

1. Quality of Life — How do you want to feel, day to day?
2. Character — Who are you becoming?
3. Intellectual Life — How are you growing?
4. Emotional Life — How do you relate to your own heart?
5. Health and Fitness — What does embodiment look like for you?
6. Love Relationships — What do you want to give and receive?
7. Parenting — How do you show up for the next generation?
8. Career — What does meaningful work mean to you?
9. Spiritual Life — How do you connect with what is sacred?
10. Social Life — What community do you want to build?
11. Financial Life — What does freedom look like?
12. Life Vision — What is the story you're writing?

Most people focus on 2-3 of these and ignore the rest. But a life by design requires all 12. Because you are not just your career. Not just your relationships. Not just your spiritual practice. You are the integration of all of it.

At the summit, we'll explore how these dimensions show up in your life. Where you're thriving. Where you're neglected. Where there's opportunity for alignment.

Start noticing now. Which dimensions feel alive? Which feel empty? Just observe. No judgment. Just truth.

emails.subject: Alignment over reaction
emails.needs_update: Says 'Twelve days' but sits 9 days out in the original schedule; fix the countdown to match.
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

Twelve days. We're almost there.

I want to leave you with one thought today: Alignment over reaction.

Most people live reactively. They respond to whatever is loudest, most urgent, or most demanding. Their days are shaped by other people's priorities, other people's emergencies, other people's expectations.

But you? You're learning something different. You're learning to pause in the Yellow Light and ask: What is aligned?

Alignment means your actions match your values. Your calendar reflects your priorities. Your energy goes toward what actually matters to you.

It's not about being selfish. It's about being sovereign. Recognizing that you are the author of your life, not a character in someone else's story.

At the summit, we'll practice this. We'll look at where you're living in reaction and where you could choose alignment instead. We'll give you tools for maintaining that choice when life gets loud.

Because the goal isn't perfect alignment. The goal is faithful next steps. One aligned choice, then another, then another.

That's how a life by design is built.

emails.subject: Final preparation --- we're almost there
emails.needs_update: Says 'Six days'; 'The speakers are prepared' needs the April lineup.
emails.body:
Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

Six days. Can you feel it?

I want you to start preparing — not just logistically, but energetically. This isn't another set of webinars to half-watch while answering emails. This is a container for transformation. And containers work best when you step into them fully.

Here's how to prepare:

🌿 Clear your calendar. Block the time. Protect it like the sacred appointment it is.
🌿 Create your space. Find a quiet spot where you can be present without interruption.
🌿 Gather your tools. Journal, pen, water, anything that helps you land in your body.
🌿 Set your intention. Why are you here? What do you hope to receive? What are you ready to release?
🌿 Come as you are. You don't need to have it together. You don't need to be "ready." You just need to show up.

The speakers are prepared. The teachings are ready. The container is held.

All that's missing is you.

Hello, my fellow Butterfly Traveler.

Three days.

I keep thinking about everyone who's registered. All the beautiful souls who said yes to something different. Who chose design over default. Who are willing to show up and be changed.

You're one of them. And I'm so glad.

In three days, we'll gather. Five speakers. Three days. One shared intention: to remember who we are and choose who we're becoming.

I don't know exactly what will happen for you. I don't know which teaching will land, which story will crack you open, which moment will shift everything. But I know this:

If you show up present, something will move. Something always moves when we're willing to be honest with ourselves.

So rest up. Prepare your heart. And get ready.

We're about to begin.
